storage.built_in: 1 TB HDD included; 1097/574-WH is sold without HDD

features: Analog input: 960H analog cameras and 720p/1080p/5MP AHD cameras; recording up to 5MP Lite (1280x1944)
IP recording bandwidth 8-24 Mbps (8 Mbps default, about +4 Mbps per disabled analog channel)
Coax-channel analytics: PID / LCD / PD / sound detection / camera tampering

Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
1 x BNC spot output (704x576) for analog channels
notes: Standard inputs are 4 BNC + 2 IP; up to 6 IP channels when analog channels are disabled.
Consumption without HDD is stated as 3.6 W.
Video outputs left out: urmet.de lists HDMI up to 1080p; the user manual lists HDMI up to 3840x2160.
Dimensions and weight left out: datasheet product data (222 x 300 x 50 mm, 1.62 kg) conflicts with the spec table (300 x 53 x 227 mm, approx. 3 kg).
Named in the Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023.
